mca_status: Active (listed public limited company; CIN prefix 'L' = listed, class 'PLC' = public limited; no strike-off/liquidation/winding-up notice found on the company's own investor disclosures)
revenue_source: Not extracted. Company publishes audited Annual Reports FY2021-22 through FY2025-26 on https://www.prostarm.com/annual-reports/ (links are file downloads, not readable as text in this session), so exact INR crore figures were not verified and are left null rather than estimated.
note: Verified from the company's own official website (prostarm.com, contact-us and financial-information pages): CIN L31900MH2008PLC368540; registered office EL-79, Electronic Zone, TTC MIDC, Mahape, Navi Mumbai, Thane 400710, Maharashtra; manufacturing unit at Pisoli, Pune, Maharashtra. Company overview page states 'Incorporated in 2008' and describes designing, manufacturing and assembling of UPS, inverters, lithium-ion battery packs, servo stabilisers, isolation transformers, plus dealing in third-party batteries and solar EPC — hence role manufacturer_trader (not a pure trader). Declared HS 850760 (lithium-ion accumulators) is consistent with the company's own 'Lithium Ion Battery Pack' product line, so no HS correction is needed. PAN and GSTIN could not be retrieved: zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, DuckDuckGo search backend was unreachable, and Bing returned irrelevant results — these fields are null because they are not confirmed, not because they are absent. Incorporation date not stated as a full date on the site (only '2008'), so left null. IMPORTANT NAME DISCREPANCY: the input bundles several aliases. 'PROSTARM INFO SYSTEMS LIMITED' is confirmed as a real, active listed entity. The variants 'PROSTAR MICRONOVA POWER SYSTEM(S) PVT LTD' / 'PROSTAR MICRONOVA POWER SYSTEMS PRIVATE LIMITED' could NOT be confirmed as a separate registered entity — no registry record was found, and the company's own 'Group Companies' page lists only 'AARCHOR Innovations Pvt Ltd', while its subsidiary pages list Prostarm Energy Systems Pvt Ltd, Prostarm Bihar BESS Pvt Ltd and Prostarm Karnataka BESS Pvt Ltd. 'Prostar Micronova Power Systems Pvt Ltd' should therefore be treated as an unverified alias/possible defunct or never-registered name until a CIN is produced; it is not rejected here because the primary legal entity in the same record is confirmed active. No rejection grounds apply to Prostarm Info Systems Limited.
